domains.backend: Request handling, APIs, databases, queues, caching.
domains.data: Transformation, parsing, serialization, pipelines, file I/O.
domains.ml: Model loading, inference, embeddings, training utilities.
domains.infra: Deployment, config management, logging, monitoring, health checks.
domains.universal: Pure utilities with no domain dependency (string ops, retry, math, date handling). If a widget could reasonably belong to two domains, it belongs here.

general_notes: Single responsibility — one widget does one thing. No global state. No project-specific code, hardcoded paths, credentials, or environment-specific values. Expose variation points as constructor parameters or function arguments — no hardcoded thresholds, colors, sizes, or behavior flags. All dependencies must be declared in widget.json tech_stack.dependencies. Examples must run and exit cleanly with no user input, no network calls, and no external dependencies. Do not modify library_notes — it is managed by Cartograph and will be restored on checkin.

language_notes.python: Use pytest for all tests — no unittest. Type hints required on all public functions. No __init__.py in tests/. No if __name__ == '__main__' blocks in src/ files. Imports ordered: stdlib, third-party, local.

domain_notes.frontend: All appearance values (colors, spacing, typography, shadows) must be exposed as CSS custom properties — hardcoded values lock consumers into your choices. Provide sensible defaults via :root or the component root but every value must be overridable. No inline styles for anything that could vary by theme.
